observations.body: Paul says a person is not justified by works of law but through faith in Jesus Christ, then speaks of union with Christ and grace.
observations.label: Paul opposes justification by works of law

payload.posture: Read Galatians 2:15–21 as evidence about faith, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The Greek phrase translated “faith in Jesus Christ” has a genitive relation that requires source-language inspection.
